card.thesis: Round 21 cell. Everything except the macro conjunct is held identical across the gate-on and gate-off pair, so any difference is attributable to the gate alone. Gate: none. This is the first round in this programme whose cards can read a non-price field at all -- FRED series were collected and displayed but unreachable by any card until 2026-08-30. The honest prior, stated before the data: this finds nothing, on a base rate of ~50 concepts and near-zero survivors. It is worth running because the class was unreachable, not because it is likely to win. Nothing in this round is promotable. See strategy-program/ROUND-21-PLAN.md for the pre-registration, the circular-shift null and the five falsifiable predictions.

card.exit: atr(10) / close > 0.05 or close crosses_below sma(200)
